task.description: Design phase for ISS-104: Add instances.artifact_hash and populate at start. This is a Type C migration issue (database schema change). Classify the requirement, create migration parameter file, create prose design document, and validate.
acceptance_criteria: Requirement classified as Type C migration
Prose design document created at src/design/iss104_artifact_hash.md
Code integration points documented (instance-start, artifact-store, reproducibility queries)

result.summary: ISS-104 classified as Type C migration (schema change). Two artefacts produced: (1) Migration parameter file templates/specs/iss104_artifact_hash.migration.yaml specifying the addition of instances.artifact_hash TEXT NULL column with full test fixtures; (2) Prose design document src/design/iss104_artifact_hash.md detailing code integration points in instance-start handler, artifact store, and reproducibility queries. No implementation code written; design-only phase complete. The migration adds the column with NULL default for backward compatibility; instance-start handler (BACKEND-DEV responsibility) will populate the hash when starting instances from repository-backed definitions.

issues.description: Repository-backed detection logic: How does instance-start determine if a definition_id is repo-backed? Current assumption is cross-ref with artifacts table (is_promoted = true). Clarification needed before BACKEND-DEV implements.

Hash computation & storage: Assumed that artifact promotion pre-computes SHA-256 and stores in artifacts table. BACKEND-DEV should confirm that src/repository/artifacts.zig :: promote() already handles this.

Audit of unavailable hashes: Design specifies silent fallback to NULL with warning in logs. Confirm whether ISS-104 requires audit log entries (INSTANCE_HASH_UNAVAILABLE event), or if that is a separate requirement.
Content hash uniqueness: Design assumes (artifacts.content_hash) is UNIQUE or treated as natural key. Confirm constraint in artifacts table schema.
